sources.entry: Bing Image Creator - Image Creator from Microsoft Designer allows you to generate captivating images based on your words using AI. #freemium

summary.name: Bing Image Creator
summary.one_liner: Bing Image Creator is Microsoft's web-based AI tool that generates images from text prompts, powered by Microsoft Designer.
use_cases: remix or reimagine an existing image
summary.what_it_does: The page is the Bing Image Creator web interface, which generates images from user text prompts using AI. It is described as part of Microsoft Designer. The page can also enhance, remix, or reimagine a user-provided image with AI. Usage is tracked through a daily count of "fast" creations, and guest users face daily creation limits, with Microsoft Rewards mentioned as a way to earn more. The page text is mostly status and error messages, so details beyond these are not stated.
notable: Daily fast-creation limits, with slower speeds after the quota is used
Earn extra creations through Microsoft Rewards
Sign-in unlocks more creations and additional models
caveats: Daily creation limits apply; guest users have a lower daily cap
Access can be suspended for content policy violations, and the page warns that images you upload may be used to improve Bing services
Not available in every country or region
